title: Diloti
chooseMove: Choose a group to take, or a value to declare

hint.declare: declares a pile you can take later
hint.trail: nothing to take, so lay the card off
hint.none: no move to recommend right now

tutorial.table: The table cards are numbered. Pick a hand card and the moves it can make appear - a same-rank card, a set summing to the played card, and any declaration on the table. **Captures do not sum to ten; they sum to the played card's own rank.**
tutorial.scores: Points come from most cards (4), each ace (1), the 10 of diamonds (2) and the 2 of clubs (1) - **eleven fixed points** - plus **10 for every xeri**, a one-card sweep of the whole table. The xeri usually decides the round.
tutorial.playerHand: Your hand. A card cannot be laid off while a **face card of the same rank** is on the table, or while you **owe a declaration**.
tutorial.playButton: Pick a card, then press a Take or Declare option. Lay off appears only when you choose neither.
tutorial.resetButton: The reset button starts a new game.
